name: @apeck14/agent-lint
description: Opinionated, agent-first linting and formatting for JavaScript and TypeScript repositories.

scripts.build: node --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js lint --fix
scripts.format: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js format --write
scripts.format:check: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js format --check
scripts.check: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js check --typecheck
scripts.deadcode: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js deadcode --production
scripts.package:check: pnpm run build && publint --strict && attw --pack . --profile esm-only --no-emoji --no-color && pnpm run test:package && npm pack --dry-run
